name: granola-pp-mcp
description: Granola API surface as MCP tools.

granola_api_key.title: GRANOLA_API_KEY
granola_api_key.description: Granola public API key, created in Granola desktop under Settings → Connectors → API keys. Creating one requires a Business or Enterprise Granola workspace; personal and free workspaces cannot issue keys. Needed to fetch new meeting data; reading data already synced into the local store needs no key.

granola_audit_api_key.title: GRANOLA_AUDIT_API_KEY
granola_audit_api_key.description: Dedicated Granola audit-log API key. Audit keys are separate from regular API keys.

granola_webhook_secret.title: GRANOLA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
granola_webhook_secret.description: Webhook signing secret used for offline delivery verification.
